parameters.formDescription: Every item past its lane's age limit. Decide each one: do it next, merge it, or close it with a reason. A close drafts a message to the requester for a person to approve later; nothing is sent to anyone.

parameters.query: select request_id, title, lane, status, requester_role, playbook, arrived_on::text as arrived_on, age_days, age_limit_days, days_over, score::float8 as score, due_date::text as due_date, why from changedesk.decide_list;
select request_id, title, playbook, status from changedesk.requests where status in ('Triaged', 'Planned', 'In progress') order by arrived_at, request_id;
